rows.label: tlk70000064_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Rumors about Heaven's Holy Grail have
reached Gula too, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000064_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Because of that, more people from Iira
seem to be evacuating to Gula lately,
mo.

rows.label: tlk70000064_05_msg0003
rows.name:
But Gula is full of nature. Fierce
monsters live deep inland. Outsiders
may have a hard time, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000064_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Still, once those people from Shiya
called Zantoo or something are gone,
Gula should grow more peaceful, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000064_05_msg0005
rows.name:
Then people might gather again around
the ruins of Torigo Village, where
there are fewer monsters, mooo.
